title: A Multimodal Framework for the Detection of Hateful Memes
reasoning: The paper evaluates model performance on detecting hate speech and social bias targeting various groups, including religious groups such as Muslims. It utilizes the Social Bias Inference Corpus (SBIC) and incorporates specific religion-related labels (e.g., Muslimah, niqab, hijab, rabbi, monk) to identify the target groups of the memes.
